notes.title: UI Improvements, Powerups Overhaul & Linux Build
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]UI Enhancements[/b] - improved the look and feel throughout the game and fixed some glitches
[*] [b]Powerups overhaul[/b] - Powerups are now saved as activatable items, allowing you to use them in a later turn
[*] [b]Linux build added[/b] - the game is now available on Linux!
[*] Removed guide page - this is no longer needed because the first boards have in-game tips that explain game mechanics.
[*] [b]Expanded Match Options[/b] – Rewrote parts of the game to allow more flexible match setups. You can now play against multiple difficulty bots, set up local matches for 2 to 4 players, play 3 vs. 1 against a bot, or even let 4 bots battle it out on their own in the Sandbox board.
[/list]

[i](These updates lay the groundwork for upcoming multiplayer features—stay tuned!)[/i]
